visualCharacteristics.layout: 2 equal columns, image anchored bottom-right of each panel
visualCharacteristics.notes: dark grey (#2a2830-ish) panels, white bold heading, white bulleted links

contentPattern.structure: 1 row x 2 cells (one cell per panel). Each cell = H2 heading (e.g. 'Shop' / 'Explore'), bulleted list of links, and an optional decorative image (last, anchored bottom-right). Panels sit side-by-side from 900px and stack below; extra cells or rows become additional panels
